$comment: The judge's few-shot pairs (docs/29 §7.2). Read by an agent at step 8 of `build-theme`, never by the product: nothing in packages/ imports this file, so it costs the binary nothing. README.md says how each pair was made.

pairs.how: The three fixes are recorded in docs/11 §7b but never existed as a commit — they were made before `technical` was first committed, on sight, from a screenshot. `before.png` is today's theme with exactly those three reverted; `after.png` is today's theme. Same camera, same specimen, same minute.

findings.finding: The tagline wraps to its own line and that line opens with a stray `/`, which reads as a glyph somebody forgot to delete. The slash is a separator between two things and it is sitting on the second one.
findings.fix: Move it to the name: `.snypd-brand > a::after { content: " /" }` rather than `.snypd-tagline::before`. At 1280 nothing changes; at 390 the line break falls after the slash instead of before it.

findings.finding: Sub-headings are set in the muted colour, so a heading is quieter than the paragraph underneath it. The level reads as less important than its own content.
findings.fix: `h3` takes `--color-text` like every other heading. Muted is for metadata, never for a level of the outline.

findings.region: the term pills, foot of the post
findings.finding: The pills sit on the flex line's stretch, so a one-line pill and a two-line pill are different heights and their labels do not share a baseline.

pairs.note: None of the three is visible to a test. The build was green, the lint clean and the tokens valid in the `before` shot.

pairs.how: `git archive c0fd84c themes/studio` shot beside today's `studio`, one camera, one specimen. The renderer is today's in both columns, so this pair shows what the *stylesheet* changed and nothing else.

findings.finding: The hero is a dark maroon gradient wash. A gradient behind the biggest type on the page is the first thing every template does and it is doing no work here — the band is already full-bleed and already dark.
findings.fix: One flat near-black. The band's edge does the separating; the wash was standing in for a decision.

findings.region: the stat row under "How it starts"
findings.finding: Three numbers and their labels float in the band with nothing tying a number to its label or separating one column from the next.
findings.fix: A hairline over each column and the label directly under its number: the rule is the grouping, and it costs one border.

findings.finding: The section opens with an unnumbered heading in the same register as the hero, so the front page has two places claiming to be the top of it.
findings.fix: A small numbered eyebrow (`01`) over the heading: the numbers make the bands a sequence, and the hero keeps the display size to itself.

pairs.session: S34 mockup → S35 as built, 18 Sep 2026
pairs.how: `before` is `docs/mock/25-home-b-1440.png`, the standalone mockup Sunny picked by eye (decision 209). `after` is `docs/mock/25-s35-1440.png`, the page as built, cropped to the same first screen. This pair is the only one whose verdict is the owner's rather than the judge's — it is here because the judge's job is to predict that verdict.

findings.region: the first screen, the right half
findings.finding: The sentence is left-set across two thirds and the right half of the first screen is empty. Sunny, on sight: *"the half beside the sentence was empty — the most important part."* An approved mockup can still be wrong on the day it is built: the mockup's empty half read as air and the built page's read as a missing element.
findings.fix: One centred column — the sentence, the film, the button, the lede, the window (decision 210). The page's one big picture moves into the space the emptiness was in.

findings.finding: Two paragraphs of body copy sit under a display sentence at 96 px with nothing between them in size. The pacing goes from very loud to very quiet in one step.
findings.fix: The lede cut to its first paragraph and typeset a size up, and the four-line window under it. What was cut: the sentence naming themes, plugins and content types, and the launch date.

pairs.note: The mockup was approved in prose *and* on a picture, and the built page was still refused. That is what step 9 exists for.
